children.description: Habitat & Ecology — In non-inundated, Atlantic rain forest, on clayey soil. At elevations of 150 – 1250 m. Flowering: August to March; fruiting: January to March, June, September, November.

children.name: Guatteria longicuspis
children.description: Habitat & Ecology — In non-inundated or periodically inundated forest (várzea, igapó), on clayey soil. At elevations of up to 300 m. Flowering: April to October; fruiting: June to February.

children.name: Guatteria macropus
children.description: Habitat & Ecology — In non-inundated, Atlantic rain forest or periodically inundated forest, on clayey soil. At elevations of 10 – 750 m. Flowering: November to July; fruiting: May to September.

children.name: Guatteria maguirei
children.description: Habitat & Ecology — In shrub islands in savannas and in forest margins adjoining savannas, or in dwarf forest over sandstone with eroded crevices, mostly on white sands. At elevations of 100 – 1200 m. Flowering: March, May, July, September, November, December; fruiting: March, November, December.

children.name: Guatteria meliodora
children.description: Habitat & Ecology — In non-inundated forest, sometimes campinarana forest or savanna forest, on sandy soil. The collection from Guyana (Clarke et al. 7132) is found in seasonally flooded forest on grey sand with Eperua, Clusia and Oenocarpus. At elevations of 125 – 240 m. Flowering: March, May, June, August, September; fruiting: August, December.

children.name: Guatteria monticola
children.description: Habitat & Ecology — In non-inundated forest or in savannas (in Guyana) on rocky outcrops or on sandy soil. At elevations of 0 – 700 m. Flowering: May, October, November; fruiting: March, October.

children.name: Guatteria myriocarpa
children.description: Habitat & Ecology — In non-inundated forest (‘ firm land’). At an elevation of c. 40 m. Flowering: May, June; fruiting: September.

children.name: Guatteria novogranatensis
children.description: Habitat & Ecology — In non-inundated forest. At elevations of 100 – 1100 m. Flowering: January, February; fruiting: October.

children.name: Guatteria oblonga
children.description: Tree or shrub of unknown height, diam not recorded; young twigs densely covered with erect, pale brown hairs to c. 1 mm long, soon glabrous. Leaves: petiole 4 – 7 mm long, 1.5 – 2 mm diam; lamina narrowly elliptic, 10 – 15 by 3 – 4.5 cm (leaf index 2.9 – 3.4), chartaceous, not verruculose, slightly shiny and dark brown above, brown below, glabrous above, primary vein densely covered with appressed to erect, brown hairs below, elsewhere rather densely covered with appressed, brown hairs to c. 1 m

children.name: Guatteria odorata
children.description: Habitat & Ecology — In secondary forest. At an elevation of c. 50 m. Flowering: March; fruiting: unknown.

children.name: Guatteria oligocarpa
children.description: Habitat & Ecology — In non-inundated, Atlantic rain forest or periodically inundated forest, on clayey to sandy soil. At elevations of 0 – 1070 m. Flowering: throughout the year; fruiting: throughout the year.

children.name: Guatteria oliviformis
children.description: Habitat & Ecology — In low, montane cloud forest. At elevations of (0 –) 700 – 2200 m. Flowering: throughout the year; fruiting: February, May, September to November.

children.name: Guatteria ouregou
children.description: Habitat & Ecology — In non-inundated, primary or secondary forest, on lateritic to sandy soil. At elevations of 0 – 200 m. Flowering: September to March; fruiting: September to February.

children.name: Guatteria paludosa
children.description: Habitat & Ecology — In non-inundated, mixed rain forest, usually along creeks, sometimes on steep hills, on lateritic soil. At elevations of 0 – 600 m. Flowering: May, June; fruiting: January, March, June, October.

children.name: Guatteria peruviana
children.description: Habitat & Ecology — In non-inundated forest or along river banks. At elevations of 125 – 580 m. Flowering: August; fruiting: September.

children.name: Guatteria pogonopus
children.description: Habitat & Ecology — In non-inundated, Atlantic rain forest, on clayey soil. At elevations of 0 – 1050 m. Flowering: throughout the year; fruiting: throughout the year.

children.name: Guatteria pohliana
children.description: Habitat & Ecology — In non-inundated forest, often on clayey soil. At elevations of 0 – 1280 m. Flowering: March to May, September; fruiting: January to March, August to December.

children.name: Guatteria polyantha
children.description: Habitat & Ecology — In ‘ highland’. At low elevations. Flowering: January; fruiting: not recorded.

children.name: Guatteria procera
children.description: Habitat & Ecology — In non-inundated, primary or secondary forest, or savanna, ‘ on peat and granite, or on granite boulders’. At elevations of 100 – 1100 m. Flowering: March, June, August, September, November; fruiting: June, August, September.

children.name: Guatteria punctata
children.description: Habitat & Ecology — In non-inundated lowland, premontane or montane forest, often on clayey soil. At elevations of 0 – 2800 m. Flowering: throughout the year; fruiting: throughout the year.

children.name: Guatteria richardii
children.description: Habitat & Ecology — In non-inundated or periodically inundated forest, on clayey to sandy soil. At elevations of 0 – 500 m. Flowering: January, February, July, September to December; fruiting: January, February, April, November.

children.name: Guatteria rigida
children.description: Habitat & Ecology — In dry or wet cerrado, sometimes in gallery forest, on sandy to rocky soil. At elevations of 100 – 1000 m. Flowering: March, June, August to December; fruiting: February, April to June, September, October.

children.name: Guatteria rotundata
children.description: Habitat & Ecology — In forest. At elevations of 0 – 500 m. Flowering: February, April, November; fruiting; February.

children.name: Guatteria rubrinervis
children.description: Habitat & Ecology — In non-inundated forest. At elevations of 100 – 600 m. Flowering: March to June, August, October; fruiting: March, April, June, July.

children.name: Guatteria rufotomentosa
children.description: Habitat & Ecology — In oak forests (‘ robledales’) (Trigobalanus excelsa). At elevations of 1000 – 1675 m. Flowering: January, February, September, December; fruiting: September.

children.name: Guatteria sabuletorum
children.description: Habitat & Ecology — In savanna (‘ campina’) or non-inundated (‘ terra firme’) forest, the type collection on dry sandy places (‘ in sabulosis siccis’). At elevations of about sea level. Flowering: January, June; fruiting: June.

children.name: Guatteria schomburgkiana
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Trop. America. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Guatteria sessilicarpa
children.description: Distribution — Panama. Habitat & Ecology — In forest. At elevations of 350 – 1000 m. Flowering: February, June, July; fruiting: March to June, August, November. Vernacular name — Panama: Canalú (Galdames et al. 3782). Note — Guatteria sessilicarpa is typical by its almost sessile monocarps, combined with coriaceous, rather densely verrucose leaves.

children.name: Guatteria slateri
children.description: Habitat & Ecology — In primary wet forest or montane (elfin) forest. At elevations of (0 –) 600 – 2100 m. Flowering: throughout the year; fruiting: throughout the year.

children.name: Guatteria stenopetala

children.name: Guatteria stipitata
children.description: Habitat & Ecology — In primary, non-inundated rain forest, on white sandy to red, clayey soil. At elevations of 100 – 1200 m. Flowering: throughout the year; fruiting: throughout the year.

children.name: Guatteria subsessilis
children.description: The native range of this species is Colombia to Guyana and N. Bolivia. It is a tree and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Guatteria tenera
children.description: Habitat & Ecology — In non-inundated forest. At elevations of 1500 – 1600 m. Flowering: April, June, July; fruiting: unknown.

children.name: Guatteria terminalis
children.description: Habitat & Ecology — In cloud forest, dominated by Cyatheaceae, Alzateaceae, Cunoniaceae and Myrtaceae, or low elfin forest with many epiphytic lichens, mosses, and ground covered by a thick layer of roots, rotten leaves and mosses. At elevations of 1795 – 2300 m. Flowering: February, June, August to November; fruiting: February, August to October.

children.name: Guatteria trichostemon
children.description: The native range of this species is Brazil (Amazonas). It is a tree and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Guatteria villosissima
